C1.worst_defect: The hero lede is one 47-word sentence with a parenthetical definition stuffed in the middle ("...signs in to your own Vendure store (Vendure is an open-source headless commerce framework). It keeps selling..."), and the badge above the H1 opens with jargon ("Pre-release · plugin 0.3.0") before the page has said what a plugin is for; it reads as four dense grey lines rather than a five-second answer.

C2.worst_defect: The home comparison table says the demo "sends ... anonymous usage events to ph.wcpos.com", a different domain that the home page never explains (who is wcpos?), so a privacy line meant to build trust makes a newcomer wonder whose product this really is.
C2.where: home.desktop.02 table row "Sales reach Vendure, once each, even offline"; home.phone.04

C3.worst_defect: Step 3 makes you hand-write two TypeScript scripts (src/generate-migration.ts and src/run-migrations.ts) and step 5 assumes "the scaffold's CORS_ORIGINS allowlist" exists without saying where it lives, so a developer who did not start from @vendure/create has to guess.

C4.worst_defect: The changelog is written for the maintainers: it cites "(ADR 0005)", "(ADR 0004)", "(#116)" and "(#117)" as plain text with no links or explanation, so those references are dead ends for a reader.

C5.worst_defect: The payment-screen screenshot on At the till shows a test product named "Tally Fixture Mug" in the cart, which looks like unfinished test data; on every docs page the grey sidebar panel also stops at about y=900 and leaves a two-tone strip down the left side below it.
C5.where: at-the-till.desktop.02 (screenshot cart line 1); docs.desktop.01, limitations.desktop.01 left column below y≈900

C6.worst_defect: The phone version of the hero till screenshot cuts its quantity column header to "Q...", and the long single-column pages (quick start runs to 9,868 px) have nothing between the top "On this page" dropdown and the next heading to tell a reader where they are.

C7.worst_defect: llms.txt lists the docs alphabetically (At the till, Changelog, Connect a till, Overview, Limitations...) rather than in reading order, so Overview and Quick start are buried mid-list; everything else (Lighthouse 98/100/100/100, sitemap, robots, search API, 404 status, share card) is in order.

overall_worst.defect: A newcomer who has never heard of VendurePOS reads on the home page that the demo sends usage events to "ph.wcpos.com", a third-party-looking domain that is never explained, which undercuts the otherwise careful, honest tone at the moment they are deciding whether to try the demo.
overall_worst.where: home.desktop.02 / home.phone.04, "Live demo or your own store" table, last row
overall_worst.fix: Name the owner in the same cell, e.g. "...to our self-hosted PostHog at ph.wcpos.com (run by WCPOS, the team behind VendurePOS), with no cookie", or link "anonymous usage events" straight to the Connect a till section that already explains it.
